name_en: Peony finale — many round bursts across the frame
name_zh: 牡丹终章 — 满屏圆形绽放
prompt_en: A full fireworks finale against pure black, a victory celebration. Many fireworks, one after another and several at the same time, streak up from the bottom of the frame as thin embers and burst all over the frame at different heights and different sizes, some left, some right, some high, some low. Each burst is a wide, perfectly round sphere of hundreds of separate sparks flying outward in every direction, each spark a small sharp point of white-hot light dragging one thin bright trail behind it. The spheres expand fast, the sparks slow and arc over, their trails thin out and break into flickering fragments that twinkle and go out one by one. New bursts keep opening while the older ones are still falling, so the whole frame is alive with sparks travelling in all directions at once, and at the very end the last sparks fade and the frame is completely black again. The sparks are white-hot at the core and fall through warm gold, and every burst is a sphere of distinct points and trails rather than a soft glowing cloud. The background is pure flat black, completely empty and perfectly still: no smoke, no haze, no mist, no fog, no atmospheric glow, no ground, no horizon, no city, no buildings, no trees, no water, no reflections, no crowd, no silhouettes, no stars, no clouds, no moon. Nothing in the frame is lit except the fireworks themselves. Locked-off static camera, no camera movement, no zoom, no push in, no pan, no tilt, no orbit, no shake, no parallax, no cuts, no scene change. No lens flare, no bloom washing over the whole frame, no vignette, no depth of field, no film grain, no motion blur smear. Every burst opens fully inside the frame and is never cropped by the edges. Clean high-contrast game VFX plate, bright light on black, no text, no numbers, no watermark, no logo, no letterboxing.
prompt_zh: 纯黑背景下的一整场烟花终章，庆祝胜利的气氛。许多烟花接连不断，也有数发同时升空：细小的火星拖着尾迹从画面下方升起，在画面各处、不同高度、以不同大小炸开，有的偏左，有的偏右，有的高，有的低。每一发都是一个宽阔而浑圆的球体，数百颗彼此分离的火星朝四面八方向外飞散，每一颗都是细小锐利的白热光点，身后拖着一条细亮的尾迹。球体迅速扩张，火星减速并划弧下坠，尾迹变细、碎成闪烁的碎屑，一颗接一颗地眨着熄灭。旧的还在下坠，新的就已经绽放，整个画面到处都是朝各个方向飞散的火星；到最后所有火星淡去，画面重新变成全黑。火星核心是白热的，下坠时转为暖金色；每一发都是由清晰分明的光点和尾迹构成的球体，而不是柔软的发光云团。背景是纯正的全黑，完全空旷、绝对静止：没有烟雾、没有雾气、没有薄雾、没有霭、没有大气辉光，没有地面、没有地平线、没有城市、没有建筑、没有树木、没有水面、没有倒影，没有人群、没有剪影，没有星星、没有云、没有月亮。画面中除了烟花本身，没有任何被照亮的东西。固定机位，镜头完全锁定，无镜头运动、无变焦、无推近、无横摇、无俯仰、无环绕、无抖动、无视差，无剪辑、无场景切换。无镜头光晕，无覆盖整个画面的泛光，无暗角，无景深虚化，无胶片颗粒，无运动模糊拖影。每一次绽放都完整地在画面内展开，绝不被画面边缘裁切。干净的高对比游戏特效素材，黑底亮光，无文字、无数字、无水印、无标志、无黑边。
